name: catch-catch-catch-to-null-catching-a-required-action-throw-returns-null
origin: RelayReader-CatchFields-test.js: RelayReader @catch @catch(to: NULL) catching a @required(action: THROW) returns null
note: `@catch(to: NULL)` on a link or an aliased inline fragment: Relay reads the selection as null when a field error or a `@required(action: THROW)` is below it; Baton reads `to: NULL` as the plain optional accessor (docs/decisions/error-directives-in-swift.md), so the selection reads present and the error stays below.
